settings.title: Settings
settings.hint: Runtime system settings, applied without a restart.

fieldHints.scraper_run_timeout_min: A scheduled run is stopped if it runs longer than this.
fieldHints.log_retention_days: Logs and run records older than this are purged daily; 0 = never. Price history is never pruned.
fieldHints.catchup_warning_min: Warn when a recovered slot is older than this (takes effect as the feature lands).
fieldHints.user_deletion_retention_days: Grace window before a deleted user is removed for good (phase 10).

featureFlags.title: Feature flags
featureFlags.hint: Dev runtime toggles. Changes apply immediately and are non-persistent — they reset to defaults when the web restarts.
featureFlags.loadError: Could not load the feature flags.
featureFlags.saveError: Could not save the feature flags.

scrapers.title: Scrapers
scrapers.hint: Schedule and operational parameters, one scraper at a time.
scrapers.scheduleHint: Set the daily run times per scraper. Times are in the server timezone; two runs must be at least 1 minute apart.
scrapers.tooClose: Too close to an existing time — runs must be ≥ 1 minute apart.
scrapers.reservedHint: Core settings applied on every run and manual scrape. They take effect on the next run — no restart.
scrapers.cacheHint: Remove the cached pages so the next run fetches fresh from the site.
scrapers.clearConfirm: This removes all cached pages for this scraper. Continue?

fieldHints.politeness_delay_ms: Minimum wait between two requests to the same site.
fieldHints.http_timeout_s: How long to wait for a response before giving up on a request.
fieldHints.cache_ttl_min: How long a fetched page is reused before fetching it again; 0 disables the cache.
fieldHints.scrape_now_min_interval_s: Minimum time before a user can run Scrape now again.

viz.title: 24-hour schedule
